critique: The render now convincingly delivers the red-on-black Form aesthetic: dense point-grid surfaces, luminous red folded filaments, and clearly different configurations between t1 and t4 establish active evolving motion. It is less distinctly kaleidoscopic than the preset name suggests, reading more as a large organic particle sphere. The form is also cropped at the top and bottom, which weakens the silhouette and makes the composition feel oversized rather than deliberately framed. The t1-to-t4 structural change is quite large, so the evolution may feel more like rapid reshuffling than continuous folding.

suggestions.why: Reduce the base shape's vertical extent so the full red particle structure sits inside frame with breathing room, producing a more intentional circular/kaleidoscopic silhouette.
Retain clearly visible evolution while making successive frames read as smoother continuous deformation instead of large rapid changes in the folded mesh.
